build_zero_shot_classifier: build a zero-shot classifier by encoding class names with templates and a CLIP model
run_zero_shot_evaluation: run zero-shot ImageNet evaluation on imagenet-val and imagenet-v2 datasets using a CLIP model
run_inference_loop: run the inference loop that encodes images and computes logits against a zero-shot classifier
test_accuracy_function: test the accuracy function that computes top-k accuracy from model logits and targets
review_zero_shot_eval: review the zero_shot_eval function to understand how it orchestrates classifier building and evaluation
